mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST declines by more than 5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month indicates strengthening consumer demand, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3% in the same quarter, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 grows by less than 1% QoQ and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3% in the same quarter.
